# Requirements Quality Checklist: Personal Expense Tracker

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of the written
requirements and design.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on
the feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all requested expense capabilities—add, list, edit, confirmed delete, filter, totals, and persistence—covered by requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Are required fields, optional description, and validation rules defined for both new and edited expenses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all fixed category values and the exclusion of user-created categories documented consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003; Data Model §Fixed Categories]
- [ ] CHK004 Are first-run empty state, no-match state, unreadable data, and failed writes each assigned a distinct required outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the requirements set define how identical-valued expenses remain individually identifiable for edit and delete? [Completeness, Data Model §Expense]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the amount range explicit at both boundaries, including the absence of a smaller product-defined cap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Are accepted and rejected amount formats clear for surrounding whitespace, digits, decimals, signs, separators, and leading zeroes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the date input representation, real-calendar validation, and the user's local “today” boundary consistent across the spec and data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004; Data Model §Expense]
- [ ] CHK009 Is description length measured consistently as trimmed Unicode code points, including the exact accepted and rejected boundaries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Are field-level validation messages distinguished from global storage/recovery errors, with the required association and unsuccessful-save outcome clear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the recovery path after unreadable saved data defined beyond displaying an error and blocking mutations? [Gap, Spec §FR-014; Contract §Storage Error State]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the per-expense safe-integer limit and exact aggregate-total rule agree across validation, data model, and acceptance criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/FR-010; Data Model §Derived View State]
- [ ] CHK013 Do category spellings and exact-match rules agree across the spec, plan, data model, and UI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003; Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK014 Does newest-first ordering consistently use expense date, creation time, and the defined tie-break without changing creation order on edit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §Derived View State]
- [ ] CHK015 Are combined-filter semantics and totals over the visible filtered set consistent across requirements and design? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Are unreadable data, unavailable storage, and ordinary empty data kept distinct across the spec and storage contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011/FR-014; Contract §Read Contract]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Does every functional requirement have at least one Given/When/Then acceptance criterion whose title includes its requirement ID? [Traceability, Spec §Functional Acceptance Tests]
- [ ] CHK018 Are boundary examples provided for maximum amount, description length, date validity, and exact totals above the per-expense limit? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002/FR-004/FR-005/FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the one-second target for 1,000 expenses paired with measurement conditions specific enough for a repeatable pass/fail decision? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-004/SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Are persistence success criteria explicit about reload, browser restart, browser profile, and cleared site data? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-012/SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary, alternate, invalid-input, and recovery scenarios all represented in the user journeys and acceptance criteria? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios/FR-013–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK022 Do edit criteria cover invalid category, date, and description values as well as an invalid amount? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007/FR-013; FR-007-AT-01]
- [ ] CHK023 Are confirmation cancel, successful delete, and persistence failure during deletion distinguished in the requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008/FR-014]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the behavior for duplicate expense values explicit in the feature requirements, not only in the data model? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities; Data Model §Expense]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are malformed JSON, unsupported schema versions, invalid records, and inaccessible storage covered without implying silent reset or partial data loss? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014; Contract §Read Contract]
- [ ] CHK026 Are full-storage write failures defined for add, edit, and delete, including preservation of the prior visible and persisted state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014; Contract §Write Contract]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the ordering of two same-date records with identical creation timestamps explicitly defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §Derived View State]
- [ ] CHK028 Does the spec state whether simultaneous tabs are supported or excluded, given the plan's one-active-tab assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; Research §Risks and Scope Notes]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Are the 320px and 1920px responsive bounds and the no-horizontal-scroll criterion stated for the full primary workflow? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-001]
- [ ] CHK030 Do accessibility requirements cover the names and error/status announcements of form controls, filters, delete confirmation, and storage-error states? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-002; Contract §Accessibility and Responsiveness]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the supported browser family/version range stated precisely enough to evaluate native ES-module and localStorage compatibility? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK032 Are localStorage confidentiality limits and any encryption expectation stated for personal expense data? [Gap, Research §Risks and Scope Notes; Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK033 Are the security, lint, test, and audit thresholds consistently documented without implying the supplied harness/configuration may be changed? [Consistency, Constitution §Quality Gates; Plan §Constitution Check]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Are the user-supplied package, ESLint, Vitest, and harness files clearly prerequisites rather than artifacts this plan will generate? [Dependency, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK035 Are localStorage's origin/profile scope and browser-clearing limitation explicit wherever persistence is promised? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012/Assumptions; Research §Risks and Scope Notes]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the one-active-tab assumption reconciled with the scope of one user on one browser, which can include multiple tabs? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions; Research §Risks and Scope Notes]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 Are all recovery and accessibility expectations required by the UI contract also stated at the specification level, rather than introduced only by the plan? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-002/FR-014; Contract §Storage Error State]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
